extracted.intended_audience: newsrooms seeking practical advice on membership strategy (editors, product teams, membership managers, media consultants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and research for news organizations on designing and implementing membership programs that convert supporters into members who contribute financially and with time/knowledge; includes step-by-step processes, case studies, coaching resources, and trainings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership as a social contract
rubrics_metrics.description: Membership is a social contract between a news organization and the community it serves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: With membership, members give their time, money, and ideas to support a cause they believe in. Design membership offers and communication that reflect reciprocal obligations and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differentiate membership from donations and subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a clear explanation of what membership is and how it differs from donations and subscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources should clarify the distinct value propositions, motivations, and benefits for members vs. donors vs. subscribers so newsrooms can choose appropriate models and messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use step-by-step processes and case studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Offer practical, step-by-step processes for important decisions and include more than three dozen case studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actionable guidance should be concrete (process steps, decision points) and illustrated by real-world examples so practitioners can adapt tactics to their context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate healthy membership communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Many loyal readers crave a sense of community, but communities are complicated and take many different forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study diverse tactics, strategies, and operational considerations that help cultivate healthy member communities on their own terms; avoid one-size-fits-all approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop memberful routines that incorporate community knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify routines that incorporate community members’ knowledge and produce value for news organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proven practices should show how to involve supporters in the site's work in ways that generate revenue and editorial/organizational value; document concrete routines from multiple sites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study the needs of news organizations and their members
rubrics_metrics.description: Research should study the needs of news organizations and their members to ground membership strategy in real needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect empirical data and practitioner input (including members themselves) to inform design decisions rather than relying on assumptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collect existing knowledge and practitioner experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Collect what’s already known about making membership work by seeking out people who have deep experience with membership models (including members themselves).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Synthesize prior research, practitioner case studies, and member testimony to build a comprehensive evidence base for recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research non-financial contribution pathways
rubrics_metrics.description: Research all the ways that community members can contribute, not just their money, but their knowledge and expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design membership programs to leverage volunteer labor, expertise-sharing, sourcing story ideas, and other member contributions in addition to fundraising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund and test innovative membership models
rubrics_metrics.description: Fund innovative membership models that are being tested at news sites as part of a global experiment to identify best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support pilots and experiments with funding and evaluation so learnings about sustainability and scalability can emerge from practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synthesize key membership lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: Synthesize the key membership lessons learned by journalism organizations around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce accessible summaries of what works, why, and in what contexts to help other newsrooms adopt and adapt successful approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide accessible learning formats (courses, recordings, coaching)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide multiple learning formats: a guide, a newsletter course, summit recordings, and coaching resources for media coaches or consultants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer flexible, on-demand and facilitator-led formats so different newsroom roles can access appropriate depth and pacing of guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage republication and translation with tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Make research available for republication and translation, asking that republishers inform the project what and where they are republishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open dissemination increases reach; track republication to understand uptake and maintain attribution; provide clear permissions and a contact channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer regional training and partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide regional support by directing newsrooms in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, Central and Eastern Europe, and Asia to partners (e.g., MDIF) that host occasional membership trainings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize regional capacity-building needs and partner with local organizations to deliver contextually relevant training and support.
